description: Fetches monthly airport production statistics reports from SWCAAC (西南地区机场生产统计系统) including passenger throughput, cargo volume, and flight operations data for airports in Southwest China (Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Tibet, Chongqing).

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - list_reports    列出可用的月度统计报告
  - get_report_data 获取指定报告的详细统计数据
  - list_options    列出可筛选的年份、地区和机场选项

report_id.description: 报告ID，用于get_report_data功能获取指定报告的详细数据
